general.label: General critique
general.instruction: Assess overall quality: anatomy, composition, lighting, style fidelity, and prompt adherence.

anatomy_focus.label: Anatomy focus
anatomy_focus.instruction: Focus on anatomy and body structure: hands, fingers, faces, proportions, posture, and limbs. Note any distortions or inconsistencies.

composition_focus.label: Composition focus
composition_focus.instruction: Focus on composition and framing: subject placement, rule of thirds, cropping, balance, negative space, and focal point.

lighting_focus.label: Lighting focus
lighting_focus.instruction: Focus on lighting: source direction, shadows, highlights, exposure, mood, and color grading.

style_fidelity.label: Style fidelity
style_fidelity.instruction: Focus on how faithfully the image matches the intended art style and the written prompt's details.
